mapper.select: SELECT user_id, book_id FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('BORROWED', 'RENEWED', 'RETURNED')
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('BORROWED', 'RENEWED') AND user_id IN #{uid} GROUP BY user_id
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'OVERDUE' AND user_id IN #{uid} GROUP BY user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND borrow_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND return_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'OVERDUE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('BORROWED', 'RENEWED')
SELECT borrow_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND borrow_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY borrow_date ORDER BY borrow_date
SELECT return_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND return_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY return_date ORDER BY return_date

SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_record br JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE br.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
